# TranZact

> TranZact is the Factory AI OS for Indian MSME manufacturers — an AI-native operating system that runs sales, purchase, inventory, production, and planning so factory owners stop being the bottleneck.

TranZact was founded in 2017 by IIT and IIM graduates (Ritesh Kumar, Sharad Sen Sharma, Rohan Sen Sharma) with Mesco Springs in Vasai, Mumbai as its first customer. It has since grown to 10,000+ manufacturers across 8 industries. In 2021 it raised a $7M Series A led by Tribe Capital (with Prime Venture Partners, Gemba Capital, and Kae Capital). The platform is hosted entirely on AWS with data stored on Indian servers.

The core premise: most Indian factory owners run their business on Tally, Excel, and WhatsApp — and on themselves. TranZact replaces that with AI Teammates that act autonomously: quotes go out, POs get raised, inventory updates, production schedules itself — without the owner in the room.

## Product Modules

- [Sales Management](https://letstranzact.ai): Lead management, enquiry tracking, quotation dispatch, CRM workflows. Handles up to 100 enquiries/month on Free tier; unlimited on paid plans.
- [Purchase Management](https://letstranzact.ai): PO creation, vendor management, material planning. Customers report 40% faster procurement (Cesare Bonetti International).
- [Inventory Management](https://letstranzact.ai): Real-time stock tracking, low-stock alerts, reorder automation, B2B inventory optimization.
- [Production Management](https://letstranzact.ai): Production scheduling, batch tracking, QC module (Dominate plan and above).
- [AI Data Agent](https://letstranzact.ai): Natural-language reporting, custom dashboards, WhatsApp alerts, proactive signals (margin slippage, overdue customers, stock risk). Available in Basic (Free) and Advanced (paid) tiers.

## Target Customers

Indian MSME manufacturers in:
- Auto Components
- Chemicals
- Electrical & Electronics
- Assembly / Industrial Machineries
- Packaging
- Engineering
- Food & Beverage
- Renewables

Primary buyer: the Managing Director / factory owner who is currently the operational bottleneck.

## Key Differentiators

- **Fast onboarding**: Live in 2–3 weeks on existing workflow. No SAP-style implementation, no IT team required.
- **Non-disruptive**: Works alongside Tally; does not require replacing existing systems.
- **WhatsApp-simple UX**: Designed for shop-floor teams with no ERP experience.
- **AI-native, not AI-bolted-on**: Built on 7 years of real manufacturing operational data.
- **India-first data residency**: All data stored on Indian AWS servers; no cross-border transfer.

## Pricing

| Plan | Price | Best for |
|---|---|---|
| Free | ₹0/month | Getting started; 100 enquiries/month, Basic AI |
| Scale | ₹12,500/month (billed yearly) | Full sales, purchase, inventory, production on AI |
| Dominate | ₹30,000/month (billed yearly) | Multi-team control, batch tracking, QC, custom API integrations |
| Enterprise | Contact sales | Large teams with complex requirements |

## Security & Compliance

- Certifications: ISO 9001, ISO 27001, SOC 2
- Hosting: AWS (India region; data never leaves Indian servers)
- Encryption at rest: 256-bit AES (AWS SSE + TDE for databases)
- Encryption in transit: HTTPS/TLS 1.2 mandatory; forward secrecy configured
- Access model: No TranZact engineer has standing production access; deployments are fully automated
- Cryptography: FIPS 140-2 compliant algorithms only
- Threat model: "Assume Breach" — Prevent, Detect, Respond, Recover with ML-enhanced alerting

- Mesco Springs (Nilesh Shah, MD): 16% increase in sales closures

- Cesare Bonetti International (Unmesh Wankhede, MD): 40% faster procurement via material planning
